scope: Synthetic diagnostics-only contracts. No user data or live providers.

results.name: Only allowlisted synthetic case IDs are retained
Unknown provider strings and extra payload fields cannot enter diagnostics
Numeric metrics reject strings, negatives and non-finite values
Attempts remain separate and completion callbacks cannot duplicate events
Provider exceptions become controlled codes without retaining messages
Snapshots cannot mutate the stored trace
Known Zod paths produce fixed length and reference codes
Unknown schema paths, keys, and messages cannot enter feedback or traces
Length repair feedback identifies exact fixed bounds without rejected text
